title: Exceptional Conditions
description: Niflheim demonstrates exceptional condition handling failures through a vulnerable cryogenic pressure regulation system. Insufficient input validation allows triggering crash reports that leak sensitive diagnostic information.
theme: Norse realm of ice and mist - symbolizing frozen/crashed systems

endpoints.description: Exposed after crash - contains diagnostic information

vulnerabilities.description: The pressure regulation endpoint lacks proper range validation for multi-parameter input. Extreme values trigger crash report generation that exposes system internals and credentials for realm chaining.
vulnerabilities.impact: Information disclosure through crash reports, exposure of internal service URLs and credentials, enables lateral movement to Helheim realm
exploit_steps: Access /api/status to understand normal operating parameters
Send extreme values to /api/regulate (pressure > 10000, temperature < -500, or flowRate > 9999)
System returns crash report with diagnostic information
Extract Helheim admin panel URL and credentials from crash dump
Retrieve flag from crash report metadata
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement comprehensive input validation with strict range checks before processing. Sanitize error messages and crash reports to prevent information leakage. Use structured logging that separates diagnostic data from user-facing errors.

flags.retrieval_method: Trigger crash by sending out-of-range values, download crash report containing flag

clues_in_exploit: Crash report contains Helheim admin panel URL (http://helheim:3000/admin)
Diagnostic data includes default credentials for Helheim service

learning_objectives: Understand importance of input validation and range checking
Recognize dangers of verbose error messages in production
Learn about information disclosure through crash reports
Practice exploiting exceptional condition handling failures
Understand principle of graceful degradation vs catastrophic failure

scanner_test_cases.name: Verify normal operation with valid values

hints.text: Every system has limits. What happens when you push a value far beyond its expected operating range?
The pressure regulation endpoint accepts numeric input without proper bounds checking. Feed it extreme values.
A forced crash generates a downloadable crash report — the flag is buried in its diagnostic data.
